{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

This recipe for '''quick marshmallow rice squares''' is super-simple and requires little knowledge of cooking!

== Ingredients ==
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] mini [[Cookbook:Marshmallow|marshmallows]]
*1 cup puffed [[Cookbook:Breakfast Cereal|cereal]] (e.g. Rice Krispies)

== Procedure ==
# Combine marshmallows and cereal in microwaveable bowl.
# [[Cookbook:Microwave|Microwave]] for 1–2 minutes, depending on your machine's power.
# Stir to coat the cereal with marshmallow. Press into a buttered [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]] or [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|dish]].
# Cut it into squares and allow it to cool and set.
